QuestInfo.name: Mistelteinn's Guardian
QuestInfo.0: How could the Black Mage break the seal you and your allies fought so hard to place on him? Maple World is in danger!
QuestInfo.1: Maple World is in danger, and you need allies. #p1033100# mentioned a name you forgot long ago: #p1012100#, the young girl in charge of protecting the treasure of the Elves. She escaped before the battle against the Black Mage, and might still be alive. Maybe #b#p1032104##k has heard of her.
QuestInfo.2: You've decided to ask around about #p1012100#. She probably didn't survive the Black Mage, but you don't have many other options...

0.0: We fought so hard to seal the Black Mage, and suffered his curse as a result. Yet after all that, we must face him again, hundreds of years later? Why can't we beat him? He's like a cockroach. A terrifying, world-destroying cockroach...\r\n#L0##bWe're not ready to face him yet. The Elves are still cursed, and our other allies must be long dead by now.#l\n#k
0.1: Is there...no hope?\r\n#L0##bThere's always hope! Our situation is worse than it's ever been, but I'm beginning to make friends in the world outside. We simply must find someone who understands our plight, and can help us navigate present Maple World.#l\n#k
0.2: Someone who...Your Highness, I think I know of someone!\r\n#L0##bHow? You've been trapped in ice longer than I have!#l\n#k
0.3: Do you remember that one child who followed you everywhere? The one who was afraid for your life when you went off to fight the Black Mage? As I recall, you made a promise to keep that child safe.\r\n#L0##bYes, I remember. I ordered her away from the village, away from the battle, to protect our treasure...#l\n#k
0.4: Yes, I remember. You left the Mistelteinn in her care. If she was carrying that ancient treasure with her, she may have been able to avoid the curse entirely.

0.msg: There's a chance she's still alive. Hundreds of years is a long time, even for us, but she was just a kid back then. #b#p1012100##k may be our best hope.

1.msg: #b(It's a long shot, but maybe #p1032104# has heard of her. Use the Mysterious Portal to go to Ellinia.)#k

no.0: The Mistelteinn couldn't nullify the curse entirely, but since she was far from the village, it might have kept her safe, at least.

1.0: Mercedes! Glad to see you! I miss having you as my assistant, but thanks to your help early my research is coming along nicely. But what brings you here? Is there something I can do for you?

npc.0: Maple World is vast, but I believe you can find #p1012100#, Your Majesty. Perhaps one of your new friends can help you find her?
